claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=3. In the cluster degeneration (eps b, eps u double, 1, -1) of the one-double-root pair space, with b_k distinct and different from u and the cluster internal Taylor minor nonzero, the normalized span at fixed T tends to the separated binary-face space Pol_(<r)+phi_1 Pol_(<M)+phi_(-1) Pol_(<M)+<phi_1 phi_(-1)>, r=binom(M,2); the non-branch Weierstrass points converging to T0 != +-1 are r simple points converging to the zeros of Q_r (the zero at 0 for odd r at scale eps); points converging to +-1 are not excluded.
claims.assessment: Working proof by blockwise limit spans (internal Taylor minor by the translation lemma, Hermite triangular basis of the confluent cluster span) and the binary-face theorem; exact Wronskian at N=5, eps=1e-8, 1e-12: three scale-1 roots within (14/3) eps of the zeros of Q_3.
claims.rationale: Closes the slope-0 gap of the confluent cluster degeneration; only the directional bubble and count attainment remain for the one-double-root class.
